description: An AI prompt component with quick commands, output rendering, copy, and rating.

parameters.name: Commands
parameters.description: Available quick-action commands displayed above the input.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes for the root element.

parameters.name: OnPromptSubmit
parameters.description: Fired when the user submits a prompt.

parameters.name: OnCommandClick
parameters.description: Fired when a command button is clicked.

parameters.name: OnOutputCopy
parameters.description: Fired when the copy button is clicked.

parameters.name: OnOutputRate
parameters.description: Fired when the user rates the output. Rating: true = positive, false = negative, null = cleared.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: The current output / response to display.

parameters.name: Placeholder
parameters.description: Placeholder text for the prompt input.
